Predicates:
Leads(x, y) ::: x leads y.
Stable(y) ::: y is a professional wrestling stable.
Includes(y, z) ::: y includes z.
Feud(x, y) ::: x has a feud with y.
Premises:
DiamondMine(y) ::: y is Diamond Mine.
Leads(RoderickStrong, y) ::: Roderick Strong leads Diamond Mine.
Includes(y, CreedBrothers) ::: Diamond Mine includes the Creed Brothers.
Includes(y, IvyNile) ::: Diamond Mine includes Ivy Nile.
Feud(Imperium, y) ::: Imperium has a feud with Diamond Mine.
Conclusion:
Leads(RoderickStrong, y) ::: Roderick Strong leads a professional wrestling stable.
